'''Consume Essence''', also known as '''Feed on Dark Side''',<ref name="GG9" /> was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] user to feed on the fear, hatred, or other negative emotions of others to make themself more powerful. It did not matter why the others were filled with dark emotions; the feelings alone would suffice. Both the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] exhibited the ability; at the age of six, the Emperor&mdash;then known as Tenebrae&mdash;was able to feed off of his stepfather's anger at his wife's affair to unlock his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|break]] the man's neck. Tenebrae continued to use the technique throughout his conquest of his homeworld [[Nathema|Medriaas]], feeding off of the suffering generated by public executions and torture. Millennia later, Scourge found that his strength in battle came from drawing strength from his opponents; but while it made him more powerful and his enemies weaker, it left him at a disadvantage when facing [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Revan" />In 1003 BBY, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]] instinctively used this power while gambling, mingling his hate and that of a Republic soldier and drawing power. Groshik, the barkeep, stated that the young miner's hate had infected everyone with [[Force Enrage|fury]] and it was all he could do to not shoot the patrons with his stun blaster.<ref name="Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

During [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|duel]] with [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the former described Maul to have fed on his anger and strength after the mortal wounding of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Maul was gaining strength while he lost his after entering a [[Force Enrage|rage]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

More than a hundred [[Time/Legends|years]] later on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt|Krayt]] would use this power to preserve his body against the [[Yuuzhan Vong|Vong]] [[Yorik-Kul|implants]] that weakened him. So great was the strength he drew from the [[Genocide on Dac|slaughter]] around him that he briefly regained his good cheer and boasted that he would not [[Death/Legends|die]] of the parasites.<ref name="Legacy 22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>
